scope: Frozen numerical/reference inputs preserved without changing their decoded bytes. Technical gzip packaging and text-extension changes do not alter the measurements. Third-party source terms are retained; the case repository license does not relicense these data.

licensing_review.status: Primary resource/publisher policies checked; distinctions and unresolved file-specific licensing recorded below. No explicit prohibition on redistributing these factual reference exports was identified.
licensing_review.important_distinction: A paper license is not automatically a separately stated dataset license, and factual scientific values may have different copyright/database treatment. No blanket CC0/CC-BY relicensing of all thirteen files is asserted. Original attribution and any applicable source terms remain.

HPA.attribution: Human Protein Atlas, release 25.1; Uhlen et al., Tissue-based map of the human proteome, Science 2015, DOI 10.1126/science.1260419.
HPA.data_policy: HPA states CC BY 4.0 for all copyrightable database parts, with attribution and a warning that third-party data constraints can apply.
HPA.file_note: Frozen TSV contents unchanged; gzip is a transport encoding. Credit HPA and the specific version/table. No redistribution ban for these tables was identified.

UniProt.attribution: The UniProt Consortium; vendor-frozen Swiss-Prot FASTA dated 2025-06-11 in its filename.
UniProt.data_policy: UniProt applies CC BY 4.0 to copyrightable database parts; its disclaimer notes patents or other rights may apply.
UniProt.file_note: The FASTA is already included elsewhere in the package and is not duplicated among these thirteen gzip assets.

OpenTargets.attribution: Open Targets Platform, release 26.09; frozen supplied custom API snapshot.
OpenTargets.data_policy: The official platform data policy marks the data CC0 1.0 and says listed source providers agreed to unrestricted use through Open Targets.
OpenTargets.file_note: The custom snapshot is not an official single-file release; its exact bytes are preserved for reproduction. No additional restriction was found in the supplied snapshot.

CPTAC_PDC.attribution: CPTAC and the PDC000116 study contributors; supplied derived COAD tumour/normal gene-abundance exports; LinkedOmics source context.
CPTAC_PDC.data_policy: The PDC official data-use guideline states CC BY 4.0 for PDC data, including redistribution and transformation with attribution.
CPTAC_PDC.file_note: These supplied normalized exports are not verified byte-identical official PDC downloads. Their transformation/custom-export provenance remains recorded; no separate restrictive file license was found. The broad CRDC policy acknowledges dataset-specific conditions and should not be replaced with a claim that every cancer dataset is unrestricted.

PRIDE.attribution: PXD073413 contributors; Komor et al., PXD012254; PRIDE/ProteomeXchange.
PRIDE.data_policy: PRIDE states datasets submitted from June 2018 are CC0; older submissions use EMBL-EBI terms. Its code and derived resources have a separate CC BY 4.0 statement. Per-project license fields were not recovered through the page/API in this check, so the general policy is distinguished from a file-specific verification.
PRIDE.file_note: Public deposited processed matrices are preserved without changing values. No explicit source prohibition on redistribution was found; do not conflate an article copyright notice with a deposited-dataset license.

SURFY.attribution: Bausch-Fluck et al. (2018), The in silico human surfaceome, PNAS 115:E10988-E10997, DOI 10.1073/pnas.1808790115; copyright 2018 the authors, published by PNAS.
SURFY.article_policy: The article is explicitly CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. This is a factual limit on the article license: noncommercial sharing, attribution and no sharing of adapted copyrightable material. It is not by itself proof that factual protein scores or this table extraction cannot be redistributed.
SURFY.file_note: Supplied TSV extraction of supplementary pnas.1808790115.sd01.xls, sheet 11.3_SURFYscores_all, header row 2; unchanged from the frozen input. No separate data-specific no-redistribution term was identified. CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 section 2(a)(4) distinguishes technical format changes from adaptations. Preserve article attribution and license notice; do not assert a new blanket unrestricted license over this source.

CSPA.attribution: Bausch-Fluck et al. (2015), A Mass Spectrometric-Derived Cell Surface Protein Atlas, PLOS ONE 10:e0121314, DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0121314.
CSPA.article_policy: The actual publisher article expressly uses CC0 public-domain dedication, rather than the generic CC BY assumption often made for PLOS articles.
CSPA.file_note: Frozen TSV extraction from S2_File.xlsx, Table A. Publisher-provided supporting factual table; no separate restrictive supplementary-data term found.

Robles.attribution: Robles J, Prakash A, Vizcaino JA, Casal JI (2024), Integrated meta-analysis of colorectal cancer public proteomic datasets for biomarker discovery and validation, PLOS Computational Biology 20:e1011828, DOI 10.1371/journal.pcbi.1011828.
Robles.article_policy: The article is CC BY and explicitly makes the complete individual/batch study available on the PRIDE FTP server. PRIDE derived-resource policy states CC BY 4.0; attribution is retained rather than inferring all historical source data are CC0.
Robles.file_note: Two exact text members of the public archive, not new patient-calibrated iBAQ. No separate restrictive term was identified for these two members.

licensing_review.publication_handling: Keep references as separately identified files and retain this source attribution. Gzip compression changes no decoded bytes. No endorsement by source projects or authors is implied; source data are supplied without warranties. This check records policy evidence, not a legal opinion.
